title: Massive 50+ hour MSFS 2024 expeditions! Ancient Silk road, America 250 & new Bush Trips
description:
Looking to take your visual exploration and route flying to the next level in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just rolled out a massive wave of curated bush trips, transcontinental overland expeditions, and structured airline missions. From flying scheduled commercial airline operations across the US to embarking on an epic 50+ hour journey across the Ancient Silk Road and exploring historic routes through Germany and Route 20, this drop brings hours of guided flying adventures.

In this comprehensive activity breakdown, we organize this week's marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL FLEET OPERATIONS
We kick off with the America 250 series featuring American Airlines, built for the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A320. This package bundles a clean American Airlines livery alongside 12 structured IFR missions featuring over 100 monitored flight events, in-flight aviation audio, and realistic airline scenarios (plus our advice on whether you should wait for the full series bundle).

🌍 HISTORICAL & TRANSCONTINENTAL EXPEDITIONS
Ready for an epic long-range touring challenge? We inspect Koschi and Nordheim Missions' massive recreation of the Ancient Silk Road. Spanning over 6,500 nautical miles and 50+ hours of flight time in the Beechcraft Baron G58 and Cessna Grand Caravan, this multi-stage journey guides you along ancient overland trade routes supported by custom audio explanations. We also explore the 100 Years of Historic US Route 20 expedition, tracing America's historic coast-to-coast highway from New England to the Pacific with integrated GPS routing.

🇩🇪 REGIONAL VFR DISCOVERY (KOSCHI)
For European low-and-slow pilots, Koschi expands the acclaimed Discover Germany series with Parts 4 and 5 in the Garmin G1000-equipped Cessna 172 Skyhawk. Part 4 takes you across an 1,100 nautical mile, 18-leg route from the Bavarian Alps along the French and Czech borders, while Part 5 guides you along the Saale and Main rivers through Thuringia and Saxony straight into Berlin. We also break down why waiting for the complete Germany bundle might be the smartest move for your sim budget.

Which of these new activities or mission packs are you loading up first? Tackling the massive 50-hour Silk Road expedition, flying commercial IFR legs with American Airlines, or discovering Germany in the Skyhawk? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and blue skies on your next flight!
